evidence: CF-06 a belief about whether a changed exit will change back (development, not confirmatory)

resources.note: Not part of the hashed rows

MBVI3: fixed: keeps no memory of what a changed exit used to do (it still re-tests when its own model resets)
BELIEF: PRIMARY: model v6, two-regime belief per changed exit, rho fixed at 1/2 (the prior mean), h = 0.01
BELIEF_H003: sensitivity of the primary to h; in no criterion
BELIEF_H03: sensitivity of the primary to h; in no criterion
VOL: reported (H-VOL): the same belief with rho learned across changes
VOL_RHO_TRUE: privileged reference: rho told the family rate (the headroom for learning it)
BELIEF_REALONLY: privileged diagnostic: the primary, archiving only genuine changes (ground truth); in no criterion
BELIEF_FALSEONLY: privileged diagnostic: the primary, archiving only false alarms (ground truth); in no criterion
